adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `next`/`previous` set `group.offset` immediately and then call `group.findMembers()` (an async `Discourse.ajax` in `group.js`). Since `currentPage`/`totalPages` are computed from `offset`/`limit`, the pager label updates as soon as `offset` is set, while `members` only updates when the AJAX resolves. There is no rejection handling/rollback in either the controller actions or `findMembers()`, so a failed request (or even a slow one) can leave the UI showing the new page number while still rendering the old `members` list indefinitely on failure.
